text_block_list.text:
One day. I heard from the teachers that 
Espoir City has been attending her classes 
with surprising diligence.

It's hard to believe... but if that's 
true, nothing could make me happier as a 
Trainer. Let's go check in on her class 
for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist's emotion here is— "I'm 
sad because my horseshoe cracked!" Right?!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... That's not quite right, Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sad because my horseshoe split. 
I'm sad because I can't run anymore.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ……Beats me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna come ask questions later so 
you better answer... I mean... please, 
dammit!

text_block_list.name: Sports Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Espo-san! There's eggshell in 
your beaten egg!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!? Eggshell!? Tch, who gives a damn 
about a piece that tiny—!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ... ......Nah, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I just gotta get rid of it, right? Take 
that!

I watched how things went for a while 
after that, and she was listening 
obediently.

She has grown wonderfully. Now, I'm sure 
she'll listen to me during training as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Who the hell would ever listen to 
you?!

I racked my brain for a while, but I still 
couldn't understand the reason for her 
attitude... Could it be that she actually 
hates me?
choice_data_list:
(I should get some fresh air and cool my 
head a bit...)

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah~... Come to think of it, I got a 
perfect score on the last Japanese test, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Y-You know! It's about that novel Mom said 
she liked!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that was in the textbook, y'know? I'm 
telling you, that modern Japanese test was 
a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? ...Nah, I'm doing just fine! I 
watch what I eat too, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! Cooking class! I made carrot 
shirishiri!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to it... back home, y'know? Any 
kind of arrangement was a total piece of 
cake!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah! See ya around!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't cause trouble for those closest to 
you either"...? —............Tch.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Welp, alright then. I'll follow the 
menu today.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, on one condition! If you drag your 
feet with instructions, you'll regret it!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Ah!? Ah!? You say somethin', punk!?!?

A careless remark slipped out and ended up 
provoking her for no reason. I had a 
terrible time trying to play it off 
afterward...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah? Shut up, it's about the vibes, the 
vibes!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I've got a lot going on over here too! 
Come on, let's run!!
